candidateSnapshot.note: The Python source was being edited concurrently. This decision is bound to the hashes below; the materialized JSON remained older than the source and the generator could not reconcile them.

blockers.title: Every materialized selector is structurally under-specified
blockers.finding: The materialized contract reduces public IDs, related parents, versions, external-owner references and a natural key to the same tenant_public_id_lookup pattern. Type, id-space, exact physical column, cardinality, version/as-of and causal join are not executable.
blockers.acceptance: Every selector occurrence must declare ROOT_TARGET, RELATED_PARENT, VERSION, NATURAL_KEY, OWNER_PORT or GENERATED_ROOT; source type/id-space; exact target table/column/type; tenant/purpose/as-of/version filters; cardinality and an executable causal join. No implicit first row is permitted.

blockers.title: All 19 queries are modeled with command/write effects
blockers.acceptance: Queries have an exact read plan and filters only; correlation is observability context. They create no command receipt, outbox row or mutation, including under error and pagination paths.

blockers.title: Required inputs are renamed guards rather than causal effects
blockers.finding: decision_input.*, TRANSITION_GUARD and request-digest membership do not demonstrate that changing a required business input changes a persisted fact, exact owner validation, deterministic derivation, response or reviewed event. The validator checks labels, not observable dataflow.
blockers.acceptance: Every required and optional field is enumerated in the independent oracle. Each accepted field has at least one concrete effect with an exact physical sink, typed owner-refetch receipt, deterministic derived sink, query filter, CAS selector or conditional output assertion. Renamed guards and digest-only membership cannot be the sole semantic effect.

blockers.title: First-write aggregate selection and unordered mutation unions lose multi-row lifecycle causality
wrongOrIncompleteAggregateOperations: modern.recruiting.offer.issue:existing candidate is CAS parent; offer is inserted and candidate must become OFFERED atomically
modern.recruiting.hire.record:hire is pending until HRM owner confirms handoff; candidate must not be marked HIRED from caller decision
modern.onboarding.template.publish:path version must select an immutable template version aggregate
modern.onboarding.task.complete:task completion evidence, task state and assignment reduction are distinct ordered effects
modern.benefits.plan.publish:path version must select an immutable benefit-plan version
modern.compplan.snapshot.publish:existing cycle APPROVED->PUBLISHED is CAS root; snapshot header and 1..N lines are immutable children
modern.wfm.schedule.publish:validated candidate, approval receipt and canonical schedule publication must be resolved before ledger append
modern.ai.kill.switch:useCaseKey is a natural-key selector, not a UUID public-id aggregate selector
blockers.acceptance: Each command declares an ordered DML plan. Every step has disposition, exact selector, assignment source per mutable column, expected row count and failure behavior; immutable columns are not updated; CAS increments exactly once. The transaction includes the real receipt and outbox and is proven atomically.

blockers.title: All materialized events discard domain payload and source causality
blockers.finding: The materialized event contract has only aggregateId/fromState/toState/aggregateVersion/occurredAt/correlationId for every command. The source draft attempts to repair this by copying every path/body field into events; that would merely expose caller assertions, including sensitive fields, and still would not prove committed facts.
blockers.acceptance: Preserve each stable registered event or perform an explicit version migration that atomically updates ownership, trace, AsyncAPI and every consumer. Every field is sourced from same-transaction post-state or a typed tenant/purpose/version/as-of owner refetch. Sensitivity and audience are explicit; raw request mirroring is forbidden. Outbox insert is in the business transaction and publish is after commit.

blockers.title: Event occurrence time is aggregate creation or unrelated business time
unrelatedFamilies: modern.learning.* uses prf_lrn_completion_evidence.completed_at, including offering creation/publish and enrollment/start
modern.listening.* uses sys_hris_listening_actions.completed_at, including response and survey creation/publish/close
blockers.acceptance: occurredAt is the owner transaction clock captured for the causal transition; createdAt and domain completion timestamps remain separate payload facts.

blockers.title: Optional-field semantics are absent and optional-to-required edges remain unsafe
blockers.acceptance: All optional inputs have ABSENT and PRESENT cases. An optional value may feed a required column/event only under an explicit total deterministic default or a conditional payload/schema branch.

blockers.title: Public identity equality and distinctness are not enforced
blockers.acceptance: Explicit equality constraints reject disagreement, while snapshot/plan/cycle IDs are asserted pairwise distinct and mapped to distinct typed physical or owner sources.

blockers.title: Compensation snapshot cannot represent or prove the canonical 1..N approved plan
blockers.finding: The request supplies lineCount but only one scalar line. The response permits 1..100000 lines. A caller can claim N while one line is appended; approval and content digest are not authoritative owner-refetched facts, and cycle CAS is not the selected lifecycle root.
blockers.acceptance: APPROVED cycle CAS, authoritative approval refetch, immutable header plus exactly N typed lines, recomputed canonical digest/count/total, distinct IDs and CompensationPlanApproved.v1 post-state payload are all in one transaction.

blockers.title: WFM accepts engine and approval outcomes from the caller
blockers.acceptance: Optimization consumes typed demand/constraint inputs; engine produces immutable evaluation lines/receipt; submission creates a real approval request/outbox; publication refetches an approved receipt and invokes the canonical schedule owner port. Counts, fairness result and schedule period are computed/refetched, never trusted caller outcomes.

blockers.title: Validator imports candidate state/write choices and therefore self-certifies
evidence: validate_modern_causal_state_contracts.py imports COMMAND_WRITES, STATE and state_column_for from modern_causal_successor.py
validator also imports build_postgres_feasibility_ddl from the candidate-family validator
post-state closure only re-observes a declared mutation source, not executed DML
foreignBusinessReferences=[] and one-event-per-command are enforced as shape rather than independently reviewed semantics
self-tests mutate the same candidate representation and expected labels
blockers.acceptance: Validation is driven by a separately sealed, reviewer-owned oracle. Candidate code is never imported. The validator compares candidate outputs to explicit operation/field/DML/event expectations and contains negative tests proving each blocker class is detected.

blockers.title: PostgreSQL probe does not exercise operation transactions
blockers.acceptance: Run isolated real operation transactions on PostgreSQL 16 and 18 for all 45 operations and 58 fixed INSERT/APPEND edges. Assert exact seed/select/CAS/DML/receipt/outbox/replay/digest conflict/stale/tenant/purpose behavior and inject failure after every ordered step to prove rollback.

mustCover: 100 operation modes and exact query read plans
all required and optional request fields with concrete effects
ordered per-table DML with assignments, selectors, row counts, CAS and rollback points
physical transition sink and CHECK-compatible post-state
stable event type and every payload source/audience/sensitivity
receipt and outbox same-transaction write plus after-commit publication
public identity equality and distinctness constraints

releaseAcceptance: Current candidate remains sealed FAIL; changing source without materializing all pinned artifacts does not change the decision.
Independent oracle validator reports zero structural and semantic errors without importing candidate modules.
All 81 commands and 19 queries have explicit operation-level acceptance records.
Every request field, including 86 optional fields, has an independently reviewed effect/absence contract.
All 91 current selector occurrences are replaced by executable typed selectors; no generic lookup remains.
Stable event payload and consumer compatibility are preserved or explicitly migrated.
PostgreSQL 16 and 18 fixtures execute all 45 operation transactions and 58 INSERT/APPEND edges with real receipts/outbox, replay/conflict/stale/tenant/purpose and step rollback evidence.
A second independent reviewer signs the oracle hash and execution evidence before any modern module code gate opens.
